# Interface: RenderedText

Defined in: [src/specification/facets/component/rendered-text.ts:12](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/specification/facets/component/rendered-text.ts#L12)

A stream captured INSIDE the page.

Structurally identical to any other [TextAccessor](../classes/TextAccessor.md) — the same
`{{token}}` grammar, the same ANSI stripping, the same `.grep()` — and
marked so the matcher augmentation can say the one thing that differs: its
golden lives on the server, so `toMatch` is awaited here where it is
synchronous everywhere else.

### grep()

```ts
grep(pattern): TextAccessor;
```

Defined in: [src/specification/facets/\_common/result/text.ts:76](https://github.com/jterrazz/package-test/blob/main/src/specification/facets/_common/result/text.ts#L76)

Keep only the blank-line-separated blocks of the text that contain
`pattern` (how linter/compiler output is structured), returned as a new
`TextAccessor` — the same subject type, so the result is chainable and
snapshot-able. The scalpel for probing large tool outputs; snapshot the
whole surface by default, reach for `.grep()` for targeted checks.
